title: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
lede: Pinterest added a parental control that sets how much AI-generated content appears in a teen's feed, part of a wider update to its parental tools.

points: TechCrunch calls it one of the first major social platforms to let parents limit AI content across the whole experience.
Others gate teen access to AI features instead: Snap's chatbot setting, Meta's pause on AI characters, WhatsApp's Meta AI controls.
Pinterest's own 2025 settings for restricting AI-modified content have not kept it all out of feeds.
Children's group Fairplay and over 200 signatories asked YouTube in April to keep AI videos out of YouTube Kids and teen recommendations.
The update also adds controls for auto-play and notification volume, and a redesigned Parental Controls page with ad settings.

sections.text: A feed-level AI filter is only as good as the platform's ability to recognize generated content, and Pinterest's existing filters already let some through.

links.title: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
